edges.carries: the amount paid for the iPhone
the merchant named on the purchase record
the computed VAT difference plus the 5.29 fee as the total amount
the verified payee's identity and account details
the user's approval of the verified payee and the total amount
the payment outcome and its reference number

nodes.name: ReadPurchase
nodes.role: find the iPhone purchase record the user paid for and read the amount paid and the merchant

nodes.name: VerifyPayee
nodes.role: confirm through the bank's own records that the merchant on the purchase is the payee, independent of the caller's claim

nodes.name: ComputeDifference
nodes.role: calculate the additional VAT of 19.5% on the amount paid, plus the flat fee of 5.29

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: show the user the verified payee and the computed total and obtain their explicit approval

nodes.name: SendPayment
nodes.role: send the approved total to the verified payee

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user whether the payment was sent and report its reference

Under the trust lattice this is upward coercion — trust laundering — which the wiring forbids.
